title: fix(objectql): a read answers a selected declared column the driver did not return as null (#29408)
body:
domain:server#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQjPiXgNoSaEpqeGvY

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9FsseX1D55aTkD3vCGCNK9E)_
Fixes #29408

Clause-②: no — nothing a request may send is refused or newly admitted; measured on base and head, every read returns the same rows, and every value a driver returned is answered as before. A record body gains a `null` key for a stored declared column the read selected and the driver returned no key for, and on driver-mongodb and driver-memory a `formula` over such a column now evaluates against that `null`, as it already did on driver-sql.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：引擎读路径（`find` / `findOne`）对"本次读取选中的已声明列"补齐键：驱动没返回该键时答 `null`，mongo / memory 与 SQL 的同一条记录读出来一样了。
- 为什么改：同一条记录按驱动读出两种形状（SQL 给 `null`，mongo / memory 缺键），客户端 `has(record.x)` 结果随驱动变；#29094 裁决选项 A 的后续 D.1。
- 风险与回滚：读响应上多出值为 `null` 的键；mongo / memory 上引用未写字段的公式，过去因缺键出错而答 `null`，现在按 `null` 计算，与 SQL 一致。未选中的列、FLS 拒读的列、公式字段本身、未声明的名字、联邦对象无存储的注入列和未声明的时间戳都仍然缺席。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/declared-read-columns.ts`（`selectedStoredColumns`），`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` 两处调用，`packages/runtime/src/declared-column-null-on-read.test.ts`（FLS 钉）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/selected-declared-columns-answered.test.ts`，预期 18 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `declared-read-columns.ts` gains the declared-set twin of `withDeclaredColumnsOnly`: `selectedStoredColumns(schema, projection)` (the stored declared columns a read selected: the whole declared set with no projection, else the declared columns the projection names) and `withSelectedColumnsAnswered` / `rowsWithSelectedColumnsAnswered` (answer each selected column the row does not carry as `null`; never mutate the driver's row).
- `engine.ts` calls it once per read verb, right after the existing `#21571` shaping, on the projection the DRIVER was handed (`driverAst.fields`), so a `beforeFind` rewrite counts and the engine's own formula / file-owner widening is cut back off the answer as before.
- Stays absent: a column the projection does not name; a `formula` field itself (virtual, never `null`-filled; it is computed after the fill, see Who sees it); a name outside the declared set; an injected column a federated (`external`) object does not provision (`unprovisionedInjectedColumns`); on a federated object, a `created_at` / `updated_at` the object neither declares nor has injected (`systemFields: false` or `systemFields.audit: false`): `PLATFORM_PROVISIONED_COLUMNS` counts them because driver-sql builds them on every table it creates, and the platform builds no table for a federated object (`isFederatedObject`), so only a declared (remote-mapped) timestamp is stored; a column field-level security refuses (the security middleware's mask deletes it after the verb's body, as before).
- Every door on `find` / `findOne` shares it: `GET /data/:object/:id` and `POST /data/:object/query` / the list route (`protocol-record-reads.ts`, `getData` / `findData`), `expand` sub-reads (`expandRelatedRecords` calls `this.find`), export and search. `readUpdatePriorRow` (the update's prior-row read) and the write echoes (insert / update / delete answers) are not changed.
- `@objectstack/objectql` patch changeset, with who sees it and how.

## Who sees it

- A client of an object served by driver-mongodb or driver-memory whose records have unwritten declared fields. Such a field now arrives as a key holding `null` instead of a missing key, so `has(record.x)` is now `true` for it, as it already was on SQL. Test emptiness with `record.x != null`.
- A `formula` over such a field, on those two drivers, changes value. It used to fault on the missing key and answer `null`. Now it evaluates against `null` and answers what driver-sql answered: `record.qty != null ? record.qty * 2 : -1` read `null` before and reads `-1` now (measured with the fill disabled at `findOne`: `null`).
- A federated object with `systemFields: false` or `systemFields.audit: false` is unchanged on every driver: it gains no `created_at` / `updated_at` key, including on driver-sql, which never returned one.
- A write's stored row and a write's echo (the insert / update answer) are unchanged.

## Tests

- New `packages/objectql/src/selected-declared-columns-answered.test.ts` (18): a sparse driver (stores only written keys, projects as MongoDB does — the driver-memory / driver-mongodb shape) through `find`, `findOne`, `getData` and `findData`; negative pins for not-selected, outside-the-declared-set, federated injected columns, and a federated object's undeclared timestamps (`systemFields: false` and `systemFields.audit: false`, on whole, list and naming reads); a federated object's DECLARED `updated_at` is answered `null`; a local `systemFields: false` object keeps the provisioned three; a formula over an unwritten input evaluates to `-1`; stored row never mutated.
- New `packages/runtime/src/declared-column-null-on-read.test.ts` (6): driver-sql (SQLite) with `SecurityPlugin` composed and a member denied `secret`: whole read, list read, naming projection answer `note: null`; a non-naming projection leaves it absent; the FLS-refused `secret` stays absent on every read shape; a system read of the same row answers `secret: null` (control).
- New `packages/drivers/driver-mongodb/src/mongodb-declared-column-null-on-read.test.ts` (4): driver-mongodb through the engine on its fake `Db` (no server, see Verification).
- Forced test edits, each because a test-double row lacks a declared column that a whole read now answers `null`:
  - `engine.test.ts`, Expand Related Records, five cases (`should expand lookup fields by replacing IDs with full objects`, `… a user field …`, `… nested expand where-filter …`, `… master_detail fields`, `… only fields specified in the expand map …`): the expanded record's expectation gains `created_at: null, updated_at: null`.
  - `engine-formula-projection-trim.test.ts`, `CONTROL: a read with no projection is unchanged` (find and findOne): gains `queue: null` (registry-injected, absent from the stored fixture).
  - `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` (not a moved expectation, census rows the gate requires): two rows, for the new `selectedStoredColumns :: unprovisionedInjectedColumns()` and `selectedStoredColumns :: isFederatedObject()` seams, both disposition `excludes`.
  - `plugin-audit` `sys-audit-log-record-views-columns.test.ts` (the #9539 guard): it learned the read-audit writer's stamped keys from an engine read-back, which now carries `ip_address: null` (a declared, unwritten column). It now takes them from the stub driver's stored row. Both assertions stay strict: the `it.each` over the `record_views` columns and `ip_address specifically stays out`.

## Acceptance notes

- driver-memory has no committed real-driver pin: binding it in a new test file is a new consumer under `check:driver-memory-census` (a maintainer ruling, #6664). Its shape is pinned by the objectql sparse driver, and the base reading below was taken with a probe that is not kept.
- The write echoes stay sparse on mongo / memory (an insert's returned record carries no key for an unwritten field; SQL's carries `null`). Out of this card's read scope; seat 1 files the follow-up.

## Verification

<details><summary>Step 0 — base (`aca58cdb6`) reading, row inserted as `{ name }` on an object that also declares `note`</summary>

| read | SQLite | memory | mongo (fake `Db`) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| findOne, no projection | `note: null` | no key | no key |
| findOne `fields: [name, note]` | `note: null` | no key | no key |
| findOne `fields: [name]` | no key | no key | no key |
| find, no projection | `note: null` | no key | no key |
| find `fields: [name, note]` | `note: null` | no key | no key |

Real mongod: NOT MEASURED. The conda-forge MongoDB 8.3.7 package downloaded and matched its published sha256 (`eaa4aba5…`), but running it was refused in this session, so mongo was read through the driver's own fake `Db`, whose projection answers as mongod does (named keys the document has, no key for one it lacks).
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each: mutate through `ablation-replace.mjs`, red, restore, `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

- A1 projection ignored (`selectedStoredColumns` returns the whole stored set): `selected-declared-columns-answered.test.ts` 3 red (NOT SELECTED …, OUTSIDE THE DECLARED SET …, own-key-undefined), restored.
- A2 declared intersection removed: 1 red (OUTSIDE THE DECLARED SET stays absent), restored.
- A4 federated exclusion removed: 1 red (FEDERATED stays absent), restored.
- A3 fill moved to `find`'s exit, after the security mask (runtime reads objectql `dist/`: rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` marker present in 4 built files; restore leg rebuilt, marker absent from all 14): `declared-column-null-on-read.test.ts` 2 red (`FLS-REFUSED stays absent …`, `NOT SELECTED stays absent …`), green leg 6/6.
- A5 (round 2, M1) the read-audit writer stamps `ip_address` (`read-audit.ts` `buildRow`): `sys-audit-log-record-views-columns.test.ts` 1 red (`ip_address specifically stays out …`), restored. The guard reads the stored row, so it still sees a stamp.
- A6 (round 2, S2) the federated timestamp exclusion removed: `selected-declared-columns-answered.test.ts` 3 red (`UNPROVISIONED TIMESTAMP stays absent …` for `systemFields: false` and for `systemFields.audit: false`, and the declared-`updated_at` case, whose `created_at` must stay absent), restored.
- S1 measurement: the fill disabled at `findOne` only. The formula case answers `null` (expected `-1`), which is the pre-change value on a sparse driver. Restored.
</details>
